reviews.evidence: Checked categorical definition End=Hom(A,A), Aut as units under composition, and that no absent sparse record is interpreted as an empty Hom-set.
Direct proof: surjectivity makes the image of the source unit act as a target unit. On R, multiplicativity of t->ct is exactly c^2=c, with c=0 or 1.
Direct linearity and idempotence proof. For Herm2C, spectral decomposition of a Hermitian idempotent has eigenvalues 0/1; rank-one projections are uu* modulo phase.
Direct real-linear normal form az+b conjugate(z), determinant |a|^2-|b|^2, and algebra-map proof using possible images of i and idempotent image of 1.
Counted explicit complex basis E,F,H and doubled real basis; checked 2id fails bracket preservation on [E,F]=H. Matrix endomorphism descriptions follow basis coefficients.

Checked conjugation determinant and multiplicativity directly and differentiated c(iX)=-i c(X), proving non-holomorphicity. Inner maps checked by multiplication cancellation. No exhaustive automorphism classification asserted.
Direct inclusion proof by restricting scalar quantifiers and adding product/unit equations; dimension uses concatenated K/F and A/K bases. Checked example conjugation and 2id separates conditions.
Direct basis calculation and root equation f(i)^2=-1 in Q(i); unital/nonunital possibilities follow idempotents of a field.
Checked characteristic preservation, Lagrange obstruction 3 does not divide 7, and the two roots of x^2+x+1 in F4; every nonzero ring map between fields sends 1 to the sole nonzero idempotent.
